about.title: Developer and teacher
about.text: I’m a developer and a teacher. For more than 5 years I’ve been building web and mobile apps — from company websites to CRMs and internal tools. For the last 4 years I’ve worked at Stanford private school, where I’m now Head of IT: I set the standards for our lessons and build the school’s digital tools myself. I love turning messy processes run on spreadsheets and paper into clear systems that save people time.
